g.text: Triangle latency / ruled latency (>1 favours ruled)
Green: ratio of method medians + exploratory 95% paired, order-stratified percentile resampling interval (50000 draws).
Grey: every raw paired speed ratio, separate from the ratio-of-medians statistic. Holm signs test paired wins, a different quantity.
Secondary analysis, not a new timing run or pre-timing preregistration. Inference assumes sufficiently independent/representative trials.
Serial dependence/runtime drift can affect inference; no cross-device, GPU rendering, ArcGIS software or real-DTM timing conclusion.
